tactics:
cases l₁ with
  | nil => simp_all
  | cons a t => cases t with
    | nil => cases l₂ <;> simp_all
    | cons b xs => skip

match l₂, h₁, h₂ with
  | [], _, _ => match l₁, h₂ with
    | [], _ => simp
    | [_], _ => simp
  | c :: cs, h₁, h₂ => skip

cases l₂ with
  | nil => rcases l₁ with _ | ⟨a, _ | ⟨b, xs⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | cons c cs => skip
